runtime/tls_transport#

The native layer under net/stream, net/tls: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under net/stream, net/tls: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Public API#

native object TlsState#

native object TlsState

A TLS client connection over a socket.

native client#

native client(origin is SocketState, versions is int, protocols is @string, server is string) is TlsState

A TLS client on origin, with allowed versions, ALPN protocols and the server name for SNI.

native server#

native server(origin is SocketState, versions is int, protocols is @string, certificates is @@byte, key is @byte) is TlsState

A TLS server over an accepted connection (#209): the certificate chain (DER, the server's own first) and its PKCS #8 private key (DER); no client certificate is asked for.
